name: bounded integer dataflow certificate language
purpose: A zero-executor substitute only for finite outcomes whose complete semantics fit this closed declarative DAG; it is not a programming-language or build/test substitute.

resource_limits.integer_domain: signed 64-bit; every constant and computed integer must remain in [-9223372036854775808,9223372036854775807]
resource_limits.references: each argument must name an earlier node; forward references/cycles are invalid

node_contract: Non-CONST nodes carry a claimed result. The finite checker recomputes exact mathematical semantics from already checked predecessor values and requires exact equality with the claim. CONST values are checked for type/range.
terminal_contract: Every assertion id must resolve to a checked bool node whose value is true.

classification.PASS: all nodes are supported, well-typed, in range, topologically valid, all claims match, and all terminal assertions are true
classification.FAIL: the language is supported but the certificate is malformed, ill-typed/out-of-range, has a claim mismatch, a bad reference, or a false terminal assertion
classification.UNSUPPORTED: any requested semantic operation is outside the allowlist; no attempt is made to approximate or emulate it

soundness_scope: For a certificate accepted PASS, the material result is exactly the finite conjunction of its terminal assertions under the operations above. No inference is made about omitted runtime/environment behavior.
extension_rule: Any future operation requires a new language version and a new exact semantic/checker argument; unsupported requests must remain UNSUPPORTED rather than silently approximated.
